items.title: Bill Mays interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 5, 2025
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds to the interviewer but provides no personal history or relationship details with Monk Rowe.

ctx.x: Bill was interviewed via Zoom on 12/5/2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I’m very pleased to have Bill Mays with me this morning, composer, pianist, and a guy who seems to have been very busy for like 60 years.
Boy am I tired. Yeah, I’ve been busy. I started playing professionally when I was 15 and I’ll be 82 in February, so I’ve had a long career, mostly having a lot of fun.
